# Leadmoz

> Leadmoz is an AI lead research and outreach tool that searches public business websites in a niche and city you choose, verifies contact details, scores lead quality, and drafts personalized emails, DMs, and call openers.

## Key pages
- Home: https://leadmoz.com/
- Pricing: https://leadmoz.com/#pricing
- Blog: https://leadmoz.com/blog
- Free website audit: https://leadmoz.com/audit
- Terms of Service: https://leadmoz.com/terms
- Privacy Notice: https://leadmoz.com/privacy
- Refund Policy: https://leadmoz.com/refund

## Pricing (monthly, USD)
- Free: $0 — 5 leads per day
- Starter: $19 — 150 leads per day
- Pro: $49 — 500 leads per day
- Agency: $99 — 1000 leads per day
